field.client_id.label: Client ID
field.client_id.help: The Client ID of your 123 open platform application.
field.client_secret.label: Client Secret
field.client_secret.help: The Client Secret (key) of your 123 open platform application.
field.private_key.label: Direct-link signing private key
field.private_key.help: Only needed to enable direct-link auth: used to sign the auth_key on download links. Leave blank if you don't use direct-link auth.
field.uid.label: Cloud drive UID
field.uid.help: Your 123 Pan account UID (visible on the web settings page); paired with the private key to sign direct links.
field.valid_duration.label: Direct-link validity (minutes)
field.valid_duration.help: How long a signed direct link stays valid, in minutes. Default 30.
field.root_folder_id.label: Root folder ID
field.root_folder_id.help: The folder ID to use as this storage's root. Default 0 means the drive's root.
